reviews.title: Scam!!!!!!
reviews.text: This is a complete scam, I accidentally signed up for their yearly subscription, and I was just trying to click out of the window. I tried to email them and they told me that the subscription had been canceled and not even charged. This was on January 9. They then charged my card repeatedly until money was deposited on it and that’s when they made the transaction. I contacted my bank, disputed the transaction and closed the card. This is a fraudulent company. They will take your money regardless if they say they have canceled the transaction, and it even shows on my Apple subscriptions that it was canceled on the ninth. The card was declined initially. Again, the support team for this app said that no money would be moved from my account.

reviews.title: SCAM!!!! Stupid don’t use this app!!!
reviews.text: I could care less about reviews but this app is stupid and whoever puts out ads about it and is sponsored by it it’s stupid respectfully. The ad never said anything about an annual or lifetime subscription before you could “claim” ur money. Also I find it really weird that when I first used the app it’s just asking me questions, the basics like my name, gender, age, where I find the app, stuff like that than it asks have I been in a accident. Like what does that have to do with anything at this moment. But I finish answering the questions and it tells me I have some money to claim, I click next and I either have to pay $40/month or $120/year to claim my money. People need to start being honest and saying u have to subscribe or pay a fee to get what they are advertising. Some people like myself are looking at these apps and stuff to get money because we are struggling. So how are we supposed to pay $40 or $120 to get money that they are promising us pretty much, by talking about it like it’s free money that us as people deserve because we have been robbed by the government and other BS. Also this means they are using the money people pay to subscribe to pay other people it’s not unclaimed money is our money like everything thing else if your gonna give away “unclaimed money” why do you need us to fund you and pay you. The person behind this should be rich or apart of the government giving back to us not using our money to pay people and calling it “unclaimed money”. They are stealing.

reviews.title: Expensive
reviews.text:
Never got to try it because it makes you pay 40$ before even knowing if you have potential money to earn, no free trial or anything to know if it’s legit before spending that much money on it, also it forced you to rate the app before even using it or you can’t go to the next screen which is super ridiculous because I don’t want to give a 1 star if it’s a good app but don’t want to mislead people giving it a 5 star if it’s not what it says it is so yeah lots of these reviews are based on people who didn’t even try it yet because in order to even move on to making your account you have to give a rating can’t even skip it so that already leads me to not trust the app and be willing to spend 40 entire dollars on it BLINDLY. 

I cannot comment on whether the app itself does what it says it does because I’m not spending that much money when I have no idea what this is even going to look like. 1 star for transparency

reviews.title: How can Apple let this be downloaded
reviews.text: This is so stupid. Oh it said i had a possible 1200 in unclaimed money. Key word there possible. Then of course the first thing it wants u to do is pay 199 for lifetime membership. Or $40 a month   But if you don’t pay then they drop the price some more. Right there telling me all they want to do is get peoples money. If it really was what it said it was. They would start with actual asking ur last name. Not just 5 questions that 500k will answer the exact same way. No date of birth asked nothing. So how can they say I have 1200 just from my first name state and age. I know as soon as I would pay it would then say oh you have $0 available to claim.

reviews.title: 1 year subscription/can’t login
reviews.text: I payed for a 1 year subscription, after that I cancelled future autopayment transactions, at first i was able to log in and apply for a few claims, later i decided to come back and login again and find possible claims, but the app wouldn’t let me see more claims or my profile until i pay for a subscription again. Not even 2 months have passed and the app wants me to pay for another subscription, the 1 year subscription hasn’t finished! I reached out to PayMe support they couldn’t help. I reached out to Apple they couldn’t help either. No refund given or help on solving this problem. So i payed for 1 year for a service not provided. I have reached out multiple times and no one has helped, i’m tired of this. Apple and PayMe stold my money and neither of them can solve the problem or give me my refund, they just blame each other. I hope as a new user you have better luck than I do!

reviews.title: Not as advertised
reviews.text: When I purchased yes purchased this app spending money which was and is significant to me they double charged and then when going into the app they do not help really all is, is a sham they provide you with no actual help no actual support or anything. I had to contact Apple because for help with the money the app said that’s who I needed to contact to get a refund. It’s just a list that you could Google if you want. I would never ever have even thought about spending the money that I’m now trying to fight to get refunded if I’d have known how little they provide and care for their customers in this app. DO NOT AND I REPEAT DO NOT PURCHASE ITS A SCAM!!!!

reviews.title: Not so helpful
reviews.text: They act like they want to be helpful when really they just want a chunk of any and all of your money and to charge you another monthly subscription to boot. If someone is looking at something like this they are not looking for another subscription. Ad acted like it was free help. I wouldn’t be as annoyed if they had just asked for one or the other but to force monthly payments when they cannot guarantee you will get something every month (more than likely you will NOT get something most months. maybe the first time you use but after that………) and then want to take a chunk of everything you get. That just screams suspicious, scammy, not something I want to be involved with. And maybe other people have no problems just forking their money over hand over fist, if so enjoy! Seems like they’re another greedy corporation who will take you for everything you’ve got!

reviews.title: Waste of Money
reviews.text: This should actually wind up in a class action suit. Not a lot to work with, doesn’t curate for you, just shows you everything, you need to click on each one to find out it that it’s obviously not for you. Every one I looked at needed me to go outside the app and sign up on my own. The first one I tried I needed to sign my name, but the page moved while I signed it making my signature a blob. I had no way to clear it and when I backed out it made it look like I needed to start over from scratch. When I finally submitted it, it told me I had already completed that one, but never took me back to the signature page. Lots of suits only for California residents. Promises way more than it delivers. Don’t bother, you can do everything this offers on your own, with less confusion and god free. There’s a reason they don’t offer a trial. I just want my money back.

reviews.title: Unbelievable
reviews.text:
So I went ahead and downloaded the app, and I purchased the yearly subscription and a few moments later they showed me a deal for the lifetime subscription. As I look through the app some more I felt as though I honestly would not check in on this regularly and so I went to cancel the subscriptions and requested a refund. That was for both subscriptions I purchased. Of course Apple denies the requested refunds! I truthfully will not use this app and yet they deny both! You would think I would at least get a refund for the first subscription purchased, but noooo! Instead, the first year has to go by AND THEN the lifetime subscription starts!!! What a load of BS!!!
So of course, I made a $100 purchase of two subscriptions for absolutely nothing, and get no refund!!!

reviews.title: DO NOT DOWNLOAD!!!!!
reviews.text: I’ve been trying to cancel my subscription,I never got the chance to even use their services & out of nowhere I’m being charged $40!! Thank god I keep my cards LOCKED AT ALL TIMES!!! But now I can use my App Store, I can’t download any other app, I can’t pay any of my actual subscription,I can’t UPDATE ANY OF MY APPS!! I ABSOLUTELY CAN NOT DO ANYTHING NOW UNLESS I PAY THAT $40!!! I could understand if I never cancelled or I actually used their services BUT I DID NOT!!!! I can’t even find a number or email for these idiots to remove this constant charge! How are yal really trying to steal money from people!!!???? Ridiculous!! I soooo regret even seeing this app!!!I will NEVER download something without knowing for sure what it’s about! The creators of apps like this LOVE TO GET YOU & take your money for absolutely NOTHING!
